preconditions.description: Attacker must have the MINTER_ROLE or be the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (owner) to call the mint function

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or MINTER_ROLE holder, call the mint() function to create new tokens out of thin air and send them to your address. This directly increases your token balance without any cost. The function is at line 1504 in the contract (mint(address account, uint256 amount)).
